data.name: Nordic Carbon
data.description: Nordic Carbon is a Danish biochar developer that sources biomass residues and deploys tailor-made pyrolysis systems to produce high-quality biochar for local soil application. The company handles facility build, commissioning, operational support, and MRV for credit issuance. Their first project site is under preparation in Ghana, with additional exploration in Zambia.
